# system

Connectivity, health, version and timezone information.

- Toolset name: `system`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 3 (3 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_get_version`

**Get GVM versions** · read-only

Get the GVM REST API contract version and the GMP protocol version reported by gvmd.

This tool takes no parameters.

### `openvas_list_timezones`

**List timezones** · read-only

List the IANA timezones known to the connected gvmd (use these names for schedules). Backends without timezone discovery answer 501.

This tool takes no parameters.

### `openvas_test_connection`

**Test GVM connection** · read-only

Verify connectivity to the GVM stack: checks gateway liveness and readiness, queries the gvmd version and makes one authenticated call to confirm the forwarded identity is accepted. Use this first if other tools fail.

This tool takes no parameters.
